summaryZh: 全球化与繁荣实验室研究全球化的起源，以及它对繁荣、公平、个人和地方市场的影响。它提供全球经济模拟的cModel和基于计算的政策评估；现有页面未展开模型的具体结构。
researchQuestions: 全球化如何源于全球分工与地方创业？
全球化如何影响个人、地方市场、繁荣与公平？

evidence.quote: The cModel simulates the global economy at the click of a button. About the cModel cBriefs present computation-based evaluations of global policies.
We investigate the origins of globalization in the worldwide division of labor and in local entrepreneurship, and we study the consequences of globalization for people and local markets.
The Globalization and Prosperity Lab (GP-lab) brings together scholars to analyze globalization and its impact on prosperity and equity.
